name: raydict-native
title: RayDict
description: A browser-independent native dictionary with parallel providers, profiles and a vocabulary notebook.
author: local-developer

commands.name: search
commands.title: 查词 / Search
commands.subtitle: RayDict
commands.description: Search enabled dictionary providers in parallel.

commands.name: lookup-selected
commands.title: 查询选中文字
commands.subtitle: RayDict
commands.description: Look up selected text, with a menu-copy compatibility fallback for WeChat.

commands.name: lookup-copy
commands.title: 兼容取词（复制选区）
commands.subtitle: RayDict
commands.description: Copy the selected text through the original app menu, restore the clipboard and look it up.

commands.name: lookup-clipboard
commands.title: 剪贴板查词
commands.subtitle: RayDict
commands.description: Preview copied text before querying, for WeChat and apps without selection access.

commands.name: manage-providers
commands.title: 管理词典与情景模式
commands.subtitle: RayDict
commands.description: Open the native settings window to manage dictionaries and profiles.

commands.name: notebook
commands.title: 生词本
commands.subtitle: RayDict
commands.description: Review saved words, contexts and notes, or send them to Anki.

commands.name: settings
commands.title: 词典设置窗口
commands.subtitle: RayDict
commands.description: Open the separate native macOS settings window.

preferences.name: recordHistory
preferences.label: 保存查词历史
preferences.title: 本地历史
preferences.description: 在本机保存查询和手动添加的上下文，可在历史命令中清空。

preferences.name: deeplKey
preferences.title: DeepL API Key
preferences.description: 可选。仅在手动运行 DeepL 时使用；:fx 密钥使用 Free 端点。

preferences.name: apiToken1
preferences.title: 自定义 API 密钥 1
preferences.description: 由自定义 Provider 的 token slot 1 引用。

preferences.name: apiToken2
preferences.title: 自定义 API 密钥 2
preferences.description: 由自定义 Provider 的 token slot 2 引用。

preferences.name: apiToken3
preferences.title: 自定义 API 密钥 3
preferences.description: 由自定义 Provider 的 token slot 3 引用。

preferences.name: ankiEndpoint
preferences.title: AnkiConnect 地址
preferences.description: 仅支持本机回环地址。需要安装 AnkiConnect 并运行 Anki。

preferences.name: ankiKey
preferences.title: AnkiConnect API Key
preferences.description: 可选，与 AnkiConnect 配置中的 apiKey 一致。

preferences.name: ankiModel
preferences.title: Anki 笔记类型
preferences.description: 必须包含下列正面和背面字段。

preferences.name: ankiFront
preferences.title: Anki 正面字段
preferences.description: 笔记类型中的准确字段名。

preferences.name: ankiBack
preferences.title: Anki 背面字段
preferences.description: 笔记类型中的准确字段名。

scripts.build: npm run build:settings && ray build -e dist -o dist
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check src tests scripts examples package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts examples package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/test-native.mjs
scripts.test:native: npm run build:settings && node --import tsx scripts/test-native.mjs
scripts.install:local: npm run build:settings && ray build -e dist
